candidate_digest_capability.interface: OwnedManifestDigest.digest(ownedManifestBytes: bounded immutable bytes) -> Effect<BoundedTypedDigest, DigestUnavailable | InvalidDigestBinding | DigestLimitExceeded>. Journal/receiver owns exact byte buffer construction, lifetime and scope; injected Layer receives no ambient source/store/transport authority.
candidate_digest_capability.ownership: One coarse injected capability acquired and released within the journal/receiver operation Effect scope; no per-field digest calls or separate collection digests standing in for the full owned manifest.
candidate_digest_capability.input_bound: At most1048576 bytes for the complete owned manifest candidate page; reject before digest acquisition/materialization if over limit. All collection/count guards still apply. This is a private unmeasured synthetic guard, not a production budget.

output_bound.meaning: Synthetic tagged test-binding label only. No SHA-256 or other cryptographic algorithm implemented, selected or qualified by these cards; no public digest/wire/profile authority.

candidate_digest_capability.admission_order: Current native/source eligibility and purpose/grant/external suppression frontier admission precede constructing or exposing personal manifest metadata to the digest capability. Repeat current admission at transaction commit. Synthetic tests supply explicit fake eligibility; source hashes and digest equality never establish grants.
candidate_digest_capability.implementation_exclusions: Portable candidate contains no builtin crypto, WebCrypto, Node crypto, Rust comparator/native I/O, realm access or user-data acquisition. No CRC or hash algorithm inferred from opaque64hex syntax.
candidate_digest_capability.failure_and_cancellation: Use only bounded fixed typed capability failures; never provider/parser exception text, raw manifest fields or caller identities in receipt/log errors. Failed acquisition/digest, cancellation or current admission change produces no send/commit/success ack; scoped release and owned buffer cleanup execute on all exits.
candidate_digest_capability.fake_binding_policy: Fake Layer accepts only exact literal byte vectors frozen before code, compares complete input bytes and returns the corresponding literal tagged digest or fixed failure. Changed bytes without an independently reviewed vector fail InvalidDigestBinding. Opaque equality is a synthetic binding check, NOT cryptographic authentication, tamper proof or sender authentication.

literal_fake_vectors.authority: Literal ASCII synthetic-manifest-vector-1 bytes and fixture digest label; no personal metadata and no claim this is canonical production manifest encoding.
No matching literal fake vector; no cryptographic tamper proof.

candidate_digest_capability.before_code: Independent reviewer approves the exact private manifest byte/vector binding used by each synthetic case and capability interface before implementation. A semantic object equality or arbitrary JSON.stringify result cannot silently replace the owned exact bytes. Existing22case positive expectations remain unchanged.
